description: This file contains test utilities for the HostResolverResults component in the net::dns namespace, including a custom matcher class for testing HostResolverEndpointResult objects, and operator overloads for output streaming.

classes.name: EndpointResultMatcher
classes.description: A custom Google Mock matcher for verifying HostResolverEndpointResult objects based on their ip_endpoints and metadata fields.

methods.name: ExpectEndpointResult
methods.description: Factory function to create a matcher for HostResolverEndpointResult objects with specified ip_endpoints and metadata matchers.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to output a HostResolverEndpointResult object in a human-readable format.
